limitations: Evaluation records must be selected and labeled independently of the measured outcomes.
The Wilson interval treats candidate records as independent; candidates from one source solution may be correlated.
Four or more paired sizes do not remove host, JVM, or harness noise. Preserve raw reports and rerun on a controlled host.
Python line-event and opcode counts are work proxies and are never reported as wall-clock speedup.

executed_cpython_opcode_events.interpretation: This is a deterministic work-count reduction, not wall-clock speedup. A success requires a lower count at every one of at least four paired sizes and complete equivalence.

executed_source_line_events.interpretation: This is a deterministic work-count reduction, not wall-clock speedup. A success requires a lower count at every one of at least four paired sizes and complete equivalence.
